query: db.posts.aggregate([ { $match: { $expr: { $anyElementTrue: { $map: { input: "$engagement_scores", as: "item", in: { $gt: ["$$item", 70] } } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, author: 1, engagement_scores: 1 } }])

db.posts.aggregate([ { $match: { $expr: { $allElementsTrue: { $map: { input: "$engagement_scores", as: "item", in: { $gt: ["$$item", 50] } } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, author: 1, engagement_scores: 1 } }])
